## Chapter 5B Evidence Routing — BOOK-013 (CIDOB AMLO Biography)

**Routing standard applied:** High-recall. Chunk included only when it contains ≥1 concrete named policy action, measured outcome, cost, distributional result, implementation finding, method/qualification, attribution fact, or contrary finding. Topic overlap, generic background, definitions, tables of contents, references, and adjacent context alone are excluded.

---

### U0001 — EXCLUDE
- **Relevant questions:** None
- **Adjacent context identified:** Confirms ruler identity, term dates (2018–2024), party affiliation (MORENA), and successor (Claudia Sheinbaum). These are necessary identifiers but carry no economic policy content.
- **Exclusion reason:** Generic biographical header, navigation scaffold, and publication metadata. No policy action, budget, appointment, outcome, cost, or distributional finding. Pure scaffolding/definitions.

---

### U0002 — EXCLUDE
- **Relevant questions:** None
- **Adjacent context identified:** Confirms carismatic leadership style, 2018 electoral victory with 53.2% of votes, PRD origins, 2000–2005 DF (Mexico City) government tenure, and 2005 desafuero episode. Provides historical framing.
- **Exclusion reason:** Narrative political history. Mentions "gestión municipal de intenso calado social" and "videoescándalo" (corruption of subordinates) but offers no concrete economic policy action, executed budget, appointment of qualified economic professionals, rule enforcement, infrastructure output, or distributional result. Topic-adjacent political context only.

---

### U0003 — EXCLUDE
- **Relevant questions:** None
- **Adjacent context identified:** Confirms 2006 presidential election (lost to Calderón by 0.56%), "Coalición por el Bien de Todos," claims of electoral "robo," "Gobierno alterno" / "presidente legítimo" parallel government. Establishes political conflict posture.
- **Exclusion reason:** Political confrontation narrative and electoral dispute. No specific economic policy content — no budgets, fiscal rules, tax policy, competition enforcement, anti-corruption actions, or distributional findings.

---

### U0004 — EXCLUDE
- **Relevant questions:** None
- **Adjacent context identified:** Documents 2012 presidential run (lost to Peña Nieto with 31.6%), PRD split, MORENA founding in September 2012, opposition to EPN's "reformas estructurales" (energética, educativa, laboral, telecomunicaciones). Establishes ideological positioning.
- **Exclusion reason:** Generic opposition stance to structural reforms. Lists reform names (energy, education, labor, telecommunications) as political targets but provides no concrete policy content, no executed budget details, no appointment processes, no rule-enforcement actions, and no measured outcomes. Position-taking only.

---

### U0005 — EXCLUDE
- **Relevant questions:** None (incidental adjacency to 5B.1, 5B.3, 5B.8)
- **Adjacent context identified:** 2018 electoral platform "Proyecto 2018" — "austeridad republicana," poverty combat, social development for vulnerable groups, fuel price reduction, energy/food self-sufficiency, anti-corruption ("erradicación de la corrupción política"), migration policy. These are the stated agenda items that would need execution evidence for 5B.1, 5B.3, 5B.8.
- **Exclusion reason:** Electoral program/planks only. No executed budgets, no enacted fiscal/tax/debt/monetary rules, no concrete infrastructure or public goods delivery, no distributional measurements, no anti-corruption enforcement actions. Programmatic intent is not policy execution. Adjacent context only — cannot serve as evidence of actual economic governance.

---

### U0006 — EXCLUDE
- **Relevant questions:** None (incidental adjacency to 5B.1, 5B.3, 5B.4)
- **Adjacent context identified:** Post-election platform description — "socialdemocracia pragmática," "ortodoxas del libre mercado," "estabilidad macroeconómica," "disciplina presupuestaria," "flotación del peso," rejection of "privatizadoras" and "extranjerización," priority for "producción nacional." Also mentions Guardia Nacional creation, "amnistía condicionada" for narco-traffickers, and despenalización of soft drugs. Identifies economic policy orientation that would require execution evidence.
- **Exclusion reason:** Policy orientation description and campaign promises. No concrete enacted fiscal/tax/debt/monetary rules, no competition/property/trade/investment regulation details, no anti-corruption enforcement against connected actors, no measured budget outcomes, no infrastructure or capacity outputs. Descriptive framing only.

---

### U0007 — EXCLUDE
- **Relevant questions:** None
- **Adjacent context identified:** USMCA trade deal ratification, migration caravans from Honduras/El Salvador/Guatemala, Trump border threats, visa-of-work offers. Establishes external economic context (trade, migration).
- **Exclusion reason:** External trade negotiation and migration management context. No domestic economic policy execution, no fiscal/tax/monetary rule enactment, no internal distributional policy, no shock-response measures, no infrastructure or public goods delivery. Foreign-facing trade and migration policy only.

---

### U0008 — EXCLUDE
- **Relevant questions:** None
- **Adjacent context identified:** Early personal biography (born 1953, Tabasco; family background; 1969 brother death; moved to Palenque, Chiapas; family ran store and later hospitality business). Establishes biographical context.
- **Exclusion reason:** Pre-adult personal biography. No policy actions, no government roles, no economic governance content. Well below any relevant evidence threshold.

---

### U0009 — EXCLUDE
- **Relevant questions:** None
- **Adjacent context identified:** UNAM political science enrollment (1972), base-level PRI membership (1976), introduction to Carlos Pellicer and Governor Leandro Rovirosa Wade, delegation to Tabasco state INI (Instituto Nacional Indigenista) in La Chontalpa and Nacajuca. Establishes early political trajectory.
- **Exclusion reason:** Early political socialization and first party positions. No specific economic policy action, no executed budget, no appointment of qualified economic professionals, no rule enforcement. Pre-governance biographical material.

---

### U0010 — EXCLUDE
- **Relevant questions:** None
- **Adjacent context identified:** COPLAMAR delegation (1978) — "edición de publicaciones en lengua indígena y ejecución de programas de impulso agrícola"; university teaching (Sociología, Pedagogía) at Universidad Autónoma de Tabasco; marriage to Rocío Beltrán Medina (1980); three children; CEPES director (1982); PRI Tabasco state committee president (January 1983). Documents party career trajectory.
- **Exclusion reason:** Party institutional roles within PRI system. While CEPES director role and COPLAMAR agricultural programs are described in functional terms, no concrete economic policy action, no qualified-professional appointment through credible process, no independent operational empowerment, no fiscal/tax/debt rule enactment, no competition or anti-corruption enforcement. Institutional role labels without material economic governance specificity.

---

**0 chunks included. 10 chunks excluded.** The first 10 chunks of this CIDOB biography are biographical/political-contextual scaffolding with no material Chapter 5B economic evidence. Material evidence for 5B.1–5B.10 would require chunks covering actual budget execution, fiscal/tax/monetary rule enactment, anti-corruption enforcement actions, infrastructure delivery outcomes, distributional measurements, and shock-response implementation — not pre-governance biography or opposition positioning.
